summary: End-to-end validation of iteration-5 features: (1) Universal DatePicker on /flights + /planner (single & multi-city); (2) MultiCityHeroes photo-essay strip above streamed multi-city itinerary; (3) Share A Trip — POST /api/share, GET /api/share/{id}, /share/[id] public page, and next/og opengraph-image endpoint. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass. Frontend: all critical selectors present and working. Regression on /hotels and /sightseeing not re-tested (per prior iteration_4 pass); no regressions observed on /planner/flights headers/theme.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/main.py: _save_shares() has no file lock — concurrent POST /api/share requests under load could clobber shares.json. Consider fcntl.flock or moving to SQLite/Mongo for production. Low priority at current traffic.

backend/main.py: /api/share/{share_id} accepts arbitrary path parameter; while safe (only dict lookup), consider validating share_id matches ^[0-9a-f]{10}$ to reject probes and return 404 fast without loading the whole shares.json.

TripPlanner.tsx handleShare: on `navigator.clipboard.writeText` failure in insecure/headless contexts, the catch falls to the old fragment URL. Consider surfacing a clearer error (or requesting clipboard-write permission) so users don't silently get a different URL shape.
TripPlanner.tsx is 1069 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting handleShare, MultiCityHeroes, and the mode-tab logic into dedicated modules.

share/[id]/page.tsx: no explicit no-store / revalidate hint — depending on Next config the shared page could be cached at edge with stale data if a share is ever updated. Currently shares are immutable so this is fine, but document the invariant.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ Bangkok Weekend share entries in /app/backend/data/shares.json via test_share.py; preseeded Kyoto share (id f147bb6702) still present and used for /share/[id] rendering test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend URL: https://refined-frontend-2.preview.emergentagent.com (the URL in review_request was different but both resolve). Multi-city 'tab' is NOT role=tab — use page.get_by_text('Multi-city', exact=True) or a button selector. CityAutocomplete has no autocomplete popup in this environment (RAPIDAPI/Photon returned no options in the test), but typing 'Bangkok'/'Bali' + pressing Enter/tabbing works — the form accepts free text and 'Plan Multi-city Trip' proceeds. Multi-city stream + heroes strip renders in <15s. POST /api/share returned 200 during E2E; toast 'Public link copied' was not detected via Playwright locator (likely due to sonner auto-dismissing before the assertion or clipboard rejection in headless). The core network call was verified via request interception. Preseeded id f147bb6702 renders the full /share view (title in Instrument Serif, Kinkakuji hero image via Wikipedia, weather chip '28° Clear', season chip 'Shoulder season BEST: APR, OCT', markdown body, and 'Open the planner' CTA linking to /planner). OG image endpoint returns image/png with 200. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_share.py — 8 tests, 3.36s.
